title: Lock Time Measurement
text: Measure time a PLL takes to reach target frequency within given tolerance, 1 input, 1 output; {Target frequency (Hz)} sets the target operating frequency of PLL to measure lock time and {Error tolerance (Hz)} sets the error tolerance for lock time measurement. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: lock time
ports.summary: Time required to achieve lock in PLL real positive scalar

params.name: Target frequency (Hz)
params.values: Target operating frequency of PLL to measure lock time 2.1e9 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Error tolerance (Hz)
params.values: Error tolerance for lock time measurement 1e5 (default) | real positive scalar
